summary: Offers advice on advertising over email and newsgroups without annoying the people who receive it. It argues that responsible, targeted, honest marketing works better than blasting unwanted messages. The memo is informational guidance, not a protocol.

eli5.summary: Don't shout your ads at everyone in the street. If you politely tell only people who want to hear, they will stay your friends.

questions: how to advertise responsibly by email
